name: automatorr-compare
description: Automatorr — head-to-head PC component comparison tool

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace server --if-present && npm run test --workspace client --if-present
